verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Agora's regions, points of presence, or the edge network that carries media, and nothing describes clients being routed to a nearby PoP. The cloud-proxy firewall-whitelisting docs (agora-docs-34) and the CDN-delivery item (agora-docs-14) are adjacent features, not documentation of the media edge network or nearest-PoP routing.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, clients connect to a nearby point of presence and the vendor documents the regions or edge network that carries media
